name: NIST SP 800-30
full_name: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notice: The assessable items are the 15 tasks of the SP 800-30 risk assessment process, with the key activities NIST lists for each task. Task statements and activities are quoted from the publication.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-30 Revision 1, Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments

control_flags.type: task: a task of the SP 800-30 risk assessment process.

scoring.summary: Percentage of tasks performed, with partial performance counting as half. NIST defines no score; this is an HCG measure of how fully the organization's risk assessment process follows SP 800-30.

rules.summary: A task is performed only when each of its key activities is performed.
The risk assessment process has four steps, prepare, conduct, communicate and maintain, and every task applies to a full risk assessment.
rules.quote: The second step in the risk assessment process is to conduct the assessment.

rules.summary: A partially performed task counts as half. This is an HCG convention.

glossary.definition: The process of identifying, estimating and prioritizing risks to organizational operations, assets, individuals, other organizations and the Nation.
The intent and method targeted at exploiting a vulnerability, or a situation and method that may accidentally exploit one.
A condition within the organization that affects the likelihood that threat events result in adverse impacts.
Tier 1 organization, Tier 2 mission and business process, Tier 3 information system.

controls.title: Identify Purpose
controls.text: Identify the purpose of the risk assessment in terms of the information that the assessment is intended to produce and the decisions the assessment is intended to support.

objectives.text: Identify the purpose of the risk assessment.

controls.title: Identify Scope
controls.text: Identify the scope of the risk assessment in terms of organizational applicability, time frame supported, and architectural/technology considerations.

objectives.text: Identify the scope of the risk assessment.

controls.title: Identify Assumptions and Constraints
controls.text: Identify the specific assumptions and constraints under which the risk assessment is conducted.

objectives.text: Identify the assumptions and constraints under which the risk assessment is conducted.

controls.title: Identify Information Sources
controls.text: Identify the sources of descriptive, threat, vulnerability, and impact information to be used in the risk assessment.

objectives.text: Identify sources of threat, vulnerability, and impact information to be used in the risk assessment (see Tables D-1, E-1, F-1, H-1, and I-1 as tailored by the organization).

controls.title: Identify Risk Model and Analytic Approach
controls.text: Identify the risk model and analytic approach to be used in the risk assessment.

objectives.text: Define or refine the risk model, assessment approach, and analysis approach to be used in the risk assessment.

controls.title: Identify Threat Sources
controls.text: Identify and characterize threat sources of concern, including capability, intent, and targeting characteristics for adversarial threats and range of effects for non-adversarial threats.

objectives.text: Identify threat source inputs (see Table D-1, as tailored by the organization).
Identify threat sources (see Table D-2, as tailored by the organization).
Determine if threat sources are relevant to the organization and in scope (see Table D-1, as tailored by the organization).
Create or update the assessment of threat sources (see Table D-7 for adversarial threat sources and Table D-8 for non-adversarial threat sources, as tailored by the organization).
For relevant adversarial threat sources: Assess adversary capability (see Table D-3, as tailored by the organization).
For relevant adversarial threat sources: Assess adversary intent (see Table D-4, as tailored by the organization).
For relevant adversarial threat sources: Assess adversary targeting (see Table D-5, as tailored by the organization).
For relevant non-adversarial threat sources: Assess the range of effects from threat sources (see Table D-6, as tailored by the organization).

controls.title: Identify Threat Events
controls.text: Identify potential threat events, relevance of the events, and the threat sources that could initiate the events.

objectives.text: Identify threat event inputs (see Table E-1, as tailored by the organization).
Identify threat events (see Table E-2 for adversarial threat events and Table E-3 for non-adversarial threat events, as tailored by the organization); create or update Table E-5.
Identify threat sources that could initiate the threat events (see Table D-7 and Table D-8, as tailored by the organization); update Table E-5.
Assess the relevance of threat events to the organization (see Table E-4, as tailored by the organization); update Table E-5.
Update Columns 1-6 in Table I-5 for adversarial risk (see Table E-5 and Table D-7); or update Columns 1-4 in Table I-7 for non-adversarial risk (see Table E-5 and Table D-8).

controls.title: Identify Vulnerabilities and Predisposing Conditions
controls.text: Identify vulnerabilities and predisposing conditions that affect the likelihood that threat events of concern result in adverse impacts.

objectives.text: Identify vulnerability and predisposing condition inputs (see Table F-1, as tailored by the organization).
Identify vulnerabilities using organization-defined information sources; create or update Table F-3.
Assess the severity of identified vulnerabilities (see Table F-2, as tailored by the organization); update Table F-3.
Identify predisposing conditions (see Table F-4, as tailored by the organization); create or update Table F-6.
Assess the pervasiveness of predisposing conditions (see Table F-5, as tailored by the organization); update Table F-6.
Update Column 8 in Table I-5 for adversarial risk; or update Column 6 in Table I-7 for non-adversarial risk (see Table F-3 and Table F-6).
Update Column 9 in Table I-5 for adversarial risk; or update Column 7 in Table I-7 for non-adversarial risk (see Table F-2 and Table F-5).

controls.title: Determine Likelihood
controls.text: Determine the likelihood that threat events of concern result in adverse impacts, considering: (i) the characteristics of the threat sources that could initiate the events; (ii) the vulnerabilities/predisposing conditions identified; and (iii) the organizational susceptibility reflecting the safeguards/countermeasures planned or implemented to impede such events.

objectives.text: Identify likelihood determination inputs (see Table G-1, as tailored by the organization).
Identify likelihood determination factors using organization-defined information sources (e.g., threat source characteristics, vulnerabilities, predisposing conditions).

Assess the likelihood of threat event initiation for adversarial threats and the likelihood of threat event occurrence for non-adversarial threats (see Table G-2 and Table G-3, as tailored by the organization).
Assess the likelihood of threat events resulting in adverse impacts, given likelihood of initiation or occurrence (see Table G-4, as tailored by the organization).
Assess the overall likelihood of threat event initiation/occurrence and likelihood of threat events resulting in adverse impacts (see Table G-5, as tailored by the organization).

Update Columns 7, 10, and 11 in Table I-5 for adversarial risk (see Table G-2, Table G-4, and Table G-5); or update Columns 5, 8, and 9 in Table I-7 for non-adversarial risk (see Table G-3, Table G-4, and Table G-5).

controls.title: Determine Impact
controls.text: Determine the adverse impacts from threat events of concern considering: (i) the characteristics of the threat sources that could initiate the events; (ii) the vulnerabilities/predisposing conditions identified; and (iii) the susceptibility reflecting the safeguards/countermeasures planned or implemented to impede such events.

objectives.text: Identify impact determination inputs (see Table H-1 as tailored by the organization).
Identify impact determination factors using organization-defined information sources.
Identify adverse impacts and affected assets (see Table H-2, as tailored by the organization); create or update Table H-4.
Assess the maximum impact associated with the affected assets (see Table H-3, as tailored by the organization); update Table H-4.
Update Column 12 in Table I-5 for adversarial risk; or update Column 10 in Table I-7 for non-adversarial risk.

controls.title: Determine Risk
controls.text: Determine the risk to the organization from threat events of concern considering: (i) the impact that would result from the events; and (ii) the likelihood of the events occurring.

objectives.text: Identify risk and uncertainty determination inputs (see Table I-1, as tailored by the organization).
Determine risk (see Table I-2 and Table I-3, as tailored by the organization); update Column 13 in Table I-5 for adversarial risk and Column 11 in Table I-7 for non-adversarial risk.

families.name: Step 3: Communicate and Share Assessment Results

controls.title: Communicate Risk Assessment Results
controls.text: Communicate risk assessment results to organizational decision makers to support risk responses.

objectives.text: Determine the appropriate method (e.g., executive briefing, risk assessment report, or dashboard) to communicate risk assessment results.
Communicate risk assessment results to designated organizational stakeholders.

controls.title: Share Risk-related Information
controls.text: Share risk-related information produced during the risk assessment with appropriate organizational personnel.

objectives.text: Share the risk assessment results and supporting evidence in accordance with organizational policies and guidance.

controls.title: Monitor Risk Factors
controls.text: Conduct ongoing monitoring of the risk factors that contribute to changes in risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, or the Nation.

objectives.text: Identify key risk factors that have been identified for ongoing monitoring.
Identify the frequency of risk factor monitoring activities and the circumstances under which the risk assessment needs to be updated.

controls.title: Update Risk Assessment
controls.text: Update existing risk assessment using the results from ongoing monitoring of risk factors.

objectives.text: Reconfirm the purpose, scope, and assumptions of the risk assessment.
Conduct the appropriate risk assessment tasks, as needed.
Communicate the subsequent risk assessment results to specified organizational personnel.
